title: Homes permitted in the year per 1,000 existing homes

projected.label: baseline units authorized by building permits

state.name: baseline units authorized by building permits in 2027, state
state.formula: P10, P50, P90 of 2,000 seeded draws of (county baseline P50 x the draw's position in the baseline's likely range) x each county's yearly share of its own point projection for 2027, summed over counties = 987.2 units, 2,018 units, 3,553 units

projected.formula: P10, P50, P90 of 2,000 seeded draws, per county and year, of (county baseline P50 x the draw's position in the baseline's likely range) x each county's yearly share of its own point projection
projected.rate_formula: 1,000 x the county's baseline P50 in the year / the county's housing units (the stock is fixed, so this is the P50 of the rate)

formula: homes = units authorized in 1, 2, 3-4 and 5+ unit buildings in the year; per 1,000 = 1,000 x homes / the county's housing units
imputed_note: Marked rows are the Census Bureau's estimates for places that did not report every month (imputed).
